text: ​Join Vonage and Google Developer Groups in NYC & Brooklyn on a most excellent adventure where we totally code in the browser, squeeze into our TARDIS, and flue back through time powered by cosmic intelligence to make a Vonage phone call to one of history's greatest minds! Allons-y!​Learn how to build an AI voice agent you can call. Using GitHub Codespaces, the Flue Framework, and the Vonage Voice API, you'll create a web application that places real phone calls to an AI agent for natural, real-time conversations. By the end of the session, you'll have a fully functioning application, hands-on experience with modern AI and voice technologies, and a project you can continue building after the workshop.​Run of Show6 PM — Doors Open Come early, grab a drink and a bite, find your people. 7:00 PM — Code Jam will begin Join Dwane Hemmings JavaScript Developer Advocate at Vonage to learn how to build an AI voice agent you can call.​The FormatTables are set up for laptops all night. Food and drinks are provided by Vonage. More technical attendees are encouraged to circulate during open build time to help people who are stuck.PartnersCo-hosted by Vonage and Google Developer Groups in NYC & Brooklyn.
